specification.name: Services Layer
specification.description: Services layer for application business logic. Contains classes for working with users, sending emails and parsing resumes.

component.name: ParseService
component.description: Service for parsing resumes using OpenAI Structured Outputs. Reads files through markitdown and extracts structured data with guaranteed format through Pydantic models.

method.name: parse_resume_file
method.description: Parses resume file and returns structured data (asynchronously)
method.async: True - uses asynchronous HTTP requests to OpenAI API
method.memory_management: Uses garbage collection to free memory
method.text_limiting: Limits text length to 50000 characters to prevent token limit exceed

method.name: _parse_with_openai_structured
method.description: Parses resume text through OpenAI Structured Outputs using OpenAIStructuredResume schema (asynchronously)
method.async: True - uses asynchronous HTTP requests to OpenAI API
method.token_limiting: Limits response to 4000 tokens to prevent limit exceed
method.memory_management: Uses garbage collection to free memory after processing

method.name: _convert_structured_to_parsed
method.description: Converts OpenAIStructuredResume to ParsedResumeData

method.name: parse_resume_to_unified
method.description: Parses resume file and returns data in UnifiedResume format

method.name: test_structured_output
method.description: Tests OpenAI Structured Outputs with sample text (asynchronously)
method.async: True - uses asynchronous HTTP requests to OpenAI API

configuration.structured_output: Uses OpenAI Structured Outputs with Pydantic models for guaranteed format
configuration.max_text_length: 50000 characters - Maximum text length for processing
configuration.max_tokens: 4000 tokens - Maximum number of tokens in OpenAI response

schemas.schema: Pydantic model for OpenAI Structured Output
Model for work experience in structured output
Model for education in structured output

component.name: PlatformChatflow
component.description: Service for interacting with external chatbot platform. Sends messages, receives responses in blocking and streaming modes, and gets message history.

method.name: chat
method.description: Sends message to chat and receives response in blocking mode

params.param: Resume ID to pass in inputs (optional)

method.name: chat_stream
method.description: Sends message to chat and receives response in streaming mode (SSE)

params.param: Resume ID to pass in inputs (optional)

method.returns: Stream of response chunks from platform with conversation_id
method.async: True - uses asynchronous HTTP requests with streaming response

method.name: get_messages
method.description: Gets message history from platform with pagination
method.returns: Response with message history from platform

schemas.schema: Message model with full data from platform

component.name: UserService
component.description: Service for working with users. Provides user creation, authentication and email confirmation.

method.name: create_user
method.description: Creates new user and sends confirmation email
method.notes: Tries to enqueue Celery task; falls back to direct email if broker is unavailable

method.name: confirm_user
method.description: Confirms user email by token

method.name: get_user_by_email
method.description: Gets user by email

method.name: authenticate_user
method.description: Authenticates user
method.notes: Password reset emails also fall back to direct send if Celery is unavailable

component.name: EmailService
component.description: Service for sending email messages with DKIM signature support. Uses MIMEText and dkim.sign for SMTP server compatibility.

method.name: send_email
method.description: Sends email with DKIM signature using MIMEText and dkim.sign

method.name: send_confirmation_email
method.description: Sends beautiful HTML email for registration confirmation using Jinja2 template
method.template: HTML template with English text and green color (#4caf50)

method.name: send_password_reset_email
method.description: Sends HTML email for password reset using Jinja2 template
method.template: HTML template with English text and green color (#4caf50)

method.name: send_confirmation_email_with_code
method.description: Sends modern HTML email for registration confirmation with both token link and 6-digit verification code
method.template: Modern HTML template with large code display, copy button, and both verification options

method.name: send_password_reset_email_with_code
method.description: Sends modern HTML email for password reset with both token link and 6-digit verification code
method.template: Modern HTML template with large code display, copy button, and both verification options

method.name: _load_dkim_key
method.description: Loads DKIM private key from file
method.returns: Private key content or empty string

component.name: PDFService
component.description: Service for generating PDF files from HTML content with watermark support. Uses WeasyPrint for HTML to PDF conversion with customizable styles and background images.

method.name: generate_pdf_from_html
method.description: Generates PDF from HTML content with conditional watermark application
method.returns: Tuple of PDF bytes and filename
method.watermark_support: Conditionally applies watermarks based on use_watermark parameter
method.premium_logic: Watermarks are applied only for non-premium users

method.name: _get_watermark_css
method.description: Generates CSS for watermarks from SVG file
method.path_conversion: Converts relative path to absolute for WeasyPrint

method.name: save_pdf_temp
method.description: Saves PDF to temporary file

method.name: create_file_response
method.description: Creates FastAPI FileResponse for PDF download

configuration.watermark_path: PDF_WATERMARK_PATH - path to SVG watermark file
configuration.single_page: Content limited to single page with cropping

watermark_features.overlay_approach: Watermarks are overlaid on resume content
watermark_features.positioning: position: fixed with z-index: 1000 for overlaying on text
watermark_features.pointer_events: pointer-events: none to prevent content blocking
